method: Every rule was judged by the real gate binary, standing in its own project — the most favourable condition there is. Each probe is a command the rule's own deny pattern matches (checked with re before it was sent) and that the rule's `why` describes. A rule that did not fire got a second pass: alone in a scratch guard, to separate a dead rule from one a neighbour catches first, and several more spellings of the same intent. Nothing was executed: every probe is a PreToolUse event on stdin, and a PreToolUse verdict runs nothing.
